sentences.en: In October 2014, psychology professor Nancy Siegel heard a story.
sentences.zh: 2014年10月，心理学教授南希·西格尔听到了一个故事。

sentences.en: It was about her specialty, the study of twins.
sentences.zh: 故事关于她的专业，也就是双胞胎研究。

sentences.en: Nancy had made a career of studying unusual cases of twins,
sentences.zh: 南希的整个职业生涯都在研究罕见的双胞胎案例，

sentences.en: but she had never heard a story like this one.
sentences.zh: 但她从未听过这样的故事。

sentences.en: A woman from a remote farming village in Colombia
sentences.zh: 哥伦比亚一个偏远农村的妇女

sentences.en: makes a day-long trek to a hospital.
sentences.zh: 跋涉了一整天来到一家医院。

sentences.en: She gives birth there to a pair of identical twin boys.
sentences.zh: 她在那里生下了一对同卵双胞胎男孩。

sentences.en: One of the twins needs more advanced medical care that isn't available.
sentences.zh: 其中一个双胞胎需要更先进的医疗护理，而当地没有。

sentences.en: One of them was extremely sick.
sentences.zh: 其中一个孩子病得非常重。

sentences.en: Since the mom is still recuperating,
a relative takes him to another hospital,
sentences.zh: 一位亲戚把他带到了另一家医院，

sentences.en: six hours away in Bogota, the capital.
sentences.zh: 远在六小时车程外的首都波哥大。

sentences.en: another set of identical twin boys has just been born.
sentences.zh: 刚好又出生了一对同卵双胞胎男孩。

sentences.en: Their mother is a seamstress who lives in the city.
sentences.zh: 他们的母亲是一位住在城里的女裁缝。

sentences.en: The hospital staff is tired and overworked.
sentences.zh: 医院的工作人员又累又 overworked（劳累过度）。

sentences.en: People were thinking about the holidays.
Now, nobody knows exactly what happens next,
sentences.zh: 现在，没有人确切知道接下来发生了什么，

sentences.en: The baby from the countryside is switched
sentences.zh: 来自乡村的婴儿被调换了

sentences.en: with one of the babies born to the mother from the city.
sentences.zh: 和城里母亲所生的其中一个婴儿。

sentences.en: By the time all the babies are sent home,
sentences.zh: 等到所有的婴儿都被送回家时，

sentences.en: one boy from each pair of identical twins
sentences.zh: 每一对同卵双胞胎中的一个男孩

sentences.en: Each family thinks their twins are fraternal.
sentences.zh: 每个家庭都以为他们的双胞胎是异卵的。

sentences.en: The homes the boys grow up in are in totally different places,
sentences.zh: 男孩们长大的地方完全不同，

sentences.en: 150 miles away from each other and a world apart.
sentences.zh: 相距150英里，宛如两个世界。

sentences.en: One, the lively capital city of Bogota,
sentences.zh: 一个在热闹的首都波哥大，

sentences.en: and the other in a very remote farming village,
sentences.zh: 另一个在一个非常偏远的农村，

sentences.en: and they'd had no modern amenities,
sentences.zh: 他们没有现代化的便利设施，

sentences.en: no schooling, things of that sort.
sentences.zh: 没有受过教育，诸如此类。

sentences.en: Researchers who studied twins knew of many examples

异地抚养的同卵双胞胎的例子。

sentences.en: But two sets of identical twins,
where one from each pair was switched into the other home,
sentences.zh: 其中每对的一个孩子被调换到了另一个家庭，

sentences.en: it had never been documented before.
sentences.zh: 这在以前从未被记录过。
这引出了引人入胜的问题。

sentences.en: 25 years later, when the truth was discovered,
Nancy says it was also deeply painful.
sentences.zh: 南希说这也伴随着深深的痛苦。

sentences.en: It was also a tragedy in the sense that
two of the twins grew up in a home
sentences.zh: 其中两个双胞胎在一个家庭中长大，

sentences.en: where they were not biologically connected,
sentences.zh: 而他们与该家庭并无血缘关系，

sentences.en: and they discovered in a matter of minutes
sentences.zh: 他们在短短几分钟内发现

sentences.en: that their identities were totally shattered.
sentences.zh: 他们的身份彻底破碎了。

sentences.en: They weren't who they thought they were.
sentences.zh: 他们并不是自己以为的那个人。

sentences.en: Their parents were not their parents.
sentences.zh: 他们的父母并非他们的亲生父母。

sentences.en: In short, everything about their life was basically a lie.
sentences.zh: 简而言之，他们生活的一切基本上都是谎言。

sentences.en: This week, we'll delve into the story of the Bogota twins,
sentences.zh: 本周，我们将深入探讨波哥大双胞胎的故事，

sentences.en: a tragedy, a soap opera, and a science experiment
sentences.zh: 这是一个悲剧、一部肥皂剧、也是一个科学实验

sentences.en: And we'll also find out why twin studies
sentences.zh: 我们还将探讨为什么双胞胎研究

sentences.en: can act as a natural experiment
sentences.zh: 可以作为一种自然实验，

sentences.en: to test some of the biggest questions about human nature.
sentences.zh: 来检验关于人性的某些重大问题。

sentences.en: How much of our lives is shaped by upbringing?
sentences.zh: 我们的生活有多少是由后天抚养塑造的？

sentences.zh: 还是我们终究难逃成为我们母亲的命运？
